description: Link an Artifact to the node it DOCUMENTS (describes without implementing): a design doc, ADR, README, runbook, instruction file or diagram. Record a file this way when something would be WRONG if it drifted out of step with the design — not every file. Fails loud if either endpoint is missing. Distinct from REALIZES (implementation) and SPECIFIES (machine-readable contract).

target_type.description:
Node type the artifact describes (e.g. `Component`, `Interface`, `Project`).
Optional since 2026-09-06: resolved from the id when omitted (the id
prefix names the type); an id held by more than one type is REFUSED, never
guessed — pass it then.

name: documents
